164        protected Object readResolve() {
165                spec = Global.getSettings().getIndustrySpec(id);
166                
167                if (buildTime < 1f) buildTime = 1f;
168                
169                modId = "ind_" + id;
170                modIds = new String[10];
171                for (int i = 0; i < modIds.length; i++) {
172                        modIds[i] = modId + "_" + i;
173                }
174                
175                if (demandReduction == null) demandReduction = new MutableStat(0);
176                if (supplyBonus == null) supplyBonus = new MutableStat(0);
177
178                if (supply != null) {
179                        for (String id : new ArrayList<String>(supply.keySet())) {
180                                MutableCommodityQuantity stat = supply.get(id);
181                                stat.getQuantity().unmodifyFlat("ind_sb");
182                        }
183                }
184                if (demand != null) {
185                        for (String id : new ArrayList<String>(demand.keySet())) {
186                                MutableCommodityQuantity stat = demand.get(id);
187                                stat.getQuantity().unmodifyFlat("ind_dr");
188                        }
189                }
190                
191                return this;
192        }

204        public void apply(boolean withIncomeUpdate) {
205                updateSupplyAndDemandModifiers();
206                
207                if (withIncomeUpdate) {
208                        updateIncomeAndUpkeep();
209                }
210                
211                applyAICoreModifiers();
212                applyImproveModifiers();
213                
214                if (this instanceof MarketImmigrationModifier) {
215                        market.addTransientImmigrationModifier((MarketImmigrationModifier) this);
216                }
217                
218                if (special != null) {
219                        InstallableItemEffect effect = ItemEffectsRepo.ITEM_EFFECTS.get(special.getId());
220                        if (effect != null) {
221                                List<String> unmet = effect.getUnmetRequirements(this);
222                                if (unmet == null || unmet.isEmpty()) {
223                                        effect.apply(this);
224                                } else {
225                                        effect.unapply(this);
226                                }
227                        }
228                }
229        }
230        
231        public void unapply() {
232                applyNoAICoreModifiers();
233                
234                Boolean wasImproved = improved;
235                improved = null;
236                applyImproveModifiers(); // to unapply them
237                improved = wasImproved;
238                
239                if (this instanceof MarketImmigrationModifier) {
240                        market.removeTransientImmigrationModifier((MarketImmigrationModifier) this);
241                }
242                
243                if (special != null) {
244                        InstallableItemEffect effect = ItemEffectsRepo.ITEM_EFFECTS.get(special.getId());
245                        if (effect != null) {
246                                effect.unapply(this);
247                        }
248                }
249        }
250        
251        protected void applyAICoreModifiers() {
252                if (aiCoreId == null) {
253                        applyNoAICoreModifiers();
254                        return;
255                }
256                boolean alpha = aiCoreId.equals(Commodities.ALPHA_CORE); 
257                boolean beta = aiCoreId.equals(Commodities.BETA_CORE); 
258                boolean gamma = aiCoreId.equals(Commodities.GAMMA_CORE);
259                if (alpha) applyAlphaCoreModifiers();
260                else if (beta) applyBetaCoreModifiers();
261                else if (gamma) applyGammaCoreModifiers();
262        }
263        
264        protected void applyAlphaCoreModifiers() {}
265        protected void applyBetaCoreModifiers() {}

267        protected void applyNoAICoreModifiers() {}

291        public void demand(String modId, String commodityId, int quantity, String desc) {
292//              if (commodityId != null && commodityId.equals("organics") && getId().contains("military")) {
293//                      System.out.println("wefwefwe");
294//              }
295                //quantity -= demandReduction;
296                // want to apply negative numbers here so they add up with anything coming in from market conditions
297                if (quantity == 0) {
298                        getDemand(commodityId).getQuantity().unmodifyFlat(modId);
299                } else {
300                        getDemand(commodityId).getQuantity().modifyFlat(modId, quantity, desc);
301                }
302                
303                if (quantity > 0) {
304                        if (!demandReduction.isUnmodified()) {
305                                getDemand(commodityId).getQuantity().modifyFlat("ind_dr", -demandReduction.getModifiedInt());
306                        } else {
307                                getDemand(commodityId).getQuantity().unmodifyFlat("ind_dr");
308                        }
309                }
310        }

348        protected void applyDeficitToProduction(int index, Pair<String, Integer> deficit, String ... commodities) {
349                for (String commodity : commodities) {
350//                      if (this instanceof Mining && market.getName().equals("Louise")) {
351//                              System.out.println("efwefwe");
352//                      }
353                        if (getSupply(commodity).getQuantity().isUnmodified()) continue;
354                        supply(index, commodity, -deficit.two, getDeficitText(deficit.one));
355                }
356        }

369        protected void applyIncomeAndUpkeep(float sizeOverride) {
370                float size = market.getSize();
371                if (sizeOverride >= 0) size = sizeOverride;
372                float sizeMult = getSizeMult(size);
373                sizeMult = Math.max(1, sizeMult - 2);
374                
375                float stabilityMult = market.getIncomeMult().getModifiedValue();
376                float upkeepMult = market.getUpkeepMult().getModifiedValue();
377//              if (hazardMultOverride >= 0) {
378//                      upkeepMult = hazardMultOverride;
379//              }
380                
381                
382                int income = (int) (getSpec().getIncome() * sizeMult);
383                if (income != 0) {
384                        getIncome().modifyFlatAlways("ind_base", income, "Base value");
385                        getIncome().modifyMultAlways("ind_stability", stabilityMult, "Market income multiplier");
386                } else {
387                        getIncome().unmodifyFlat("ind_base");
388                        getIncome().unmodifyMult("ind_stability");
389                }
390                
391                
392                int upkeep = (int) (getSpec().getUpkeep() * sizeMult);
393                if (upkeep != 0) {
394                        getUpkeep().modifyFlatAlways("ind_base", upkeep, "Base value");
395                        getUpkeep().modifyMultAlways("ind_hazard", upkeepMult, "Market upkeep multiplier");
396                } else {
397                        getUpkeep().unmodifyFlat("ind_base");
398                        getUpkeep().unmodifyMult("ind_hazard");
399                }
400                
401                applyAICoreToIncomeAndUpkeep();
402                
403                if (!isFunctional()) {
404                        getIncome().unmodifyFlat("ind_base");
405                        getIncome().unmodifyMult("ind_stability");
406                }
407        }

445        protected boolean wasDisrupted = false;
446        public void advance(float amount) {
447                boolean disrupted = isDisrupted();
448                if (!disrupted && wasDisrupted) {
449                        disruptionFinished();
450                }
451                wasDisrupted = disrupted;
452                
453//              if (disrupted) {
454//                      //if (DebugFlags.COLONY_DEBUG) {
455//                              String key = getDisruptedKey();
456//                              market.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset(key);     
457//                      //}
458//              }
459                
460                if (building && !disrupted) {
461                        float days = Global.getSector().getClock().convertToDays(amount);
462                        //DebugFlags.COLONY_DEBUG = true;
463                        if (DebugFlags.COLONY_DEBUG) {
464                                days *= 100f;
465                        }
466                        buildProgress += days;
467                        
468                        if (buildProgress >= buildTime) {
469                                finishBuildingOrUpgrading();
470                        }
471                }
472                
473        }

559        public void finishBuildingOrUpgrading() {
560                building = false;
561                buildProgress = 0;
562                buildTime = 1f;
563                if (upgradeId != null) {
564                        market.removeIndustry(getId(), null, true);
565                        market.addIndustry(upgradeId);
566                        BaseIndustry industry = (BaseIndustry) market.getIndustry(upgradeId);
567                        industry.setAICoreId(getAICoreId());
568                        industry.setImproved(isImproved());
569                        industry.upgradeFinished(this);
570                        industry.reapply();
571                } else {
572                        buildingFinished();
573                        reapply();
574                }
575        }

613        public static void buildNextInQueue(MarketAPI market) {
614                ConstructionQueueItem next = null;
615                Iterator<ConstructionQueueItem> iter = market.getConstructionQueue().getItems().iterator();
616                while (iter.hasNext()) {
617                        next = iter.next();
618                        iter.remove();
619                        
620                        Industry ind = market.instantiateIndustry(next.id);
621                        int num = Misc.getNumIndustries(market);
622                        int max = Misc.getMaxIndustries(market);
623                        if (ind.isAvailableToBuild() && (num <= max || !ind.isIndustry())) { // <= because num includes what's queued
624                                break;
625                        } else {
626                                if (market.isPlayerOwned()) {
627                                        MessageIntel intel = new MessageIntel(ind.getCurrentName() + " at " + market.getName(), Misc.getBasePlayerColor());
628                                        intel.addLine(BaseIntelPlugin.BULLET + "Construction aborted");
629                                        
630                                        int refund = next.cost;
631                                        Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getCargo().getCredits().add(refund);
632                                        intel.addLine(BaseIntelPlugin.BULLET + "%s refunded", 
633                                                        Misc.getTextColor(),
634                                                        new String [] {Misc.getDGSCredits(refund)}, Misc.getHighlightColor());
635                                        intel.setIcon(Global.getSector().getPlayerFaction().getCrest());
636                                        intel.setSound(BaseIntelPlugin.getSoundStandardUpdate());
637                                        Global.getSector().getCampaignUI().addMessage(intel, MessageClickAction.COLONY_INFO, market);
638                                }
639                                next = null;
640                        }
641                }
642
643                if (next != null) {
644                        market.addIndustry(next.id);
645                        Industry ind = market.getIndustry(next.id);
646                        ind.startBuilding();
647                        if (ind instanceof BaseIndustry) {
648                                ((BaseIndustry)ind).setBuildCostOverride(next.cost);
649                        }
650                        
651                        if (market.isPlayerOwned()) {
652                                MessageIntel intel = new MessageIntel(ind.getCurrentName() + " at " + market.getName(), Misc.getBasePlayerColor());
653                                intel.addLine(BaseIntelPlugin.BULLET + "Construction started");
654                                intel.setIcon(Global.getSector().getPlayerFaction().getCrest());
655                                intel.setSound(BaseIntelPlugin.getSoundStandardUpdate());
656                                Global.getSector().getCampaignUI().addMessage(intel, MessageClickAction.COLONY_INFO, market);
657                        }
658                }
659        }

667        protected void sendBuildOrUpgradeMessage() {

677        public void notifyBeingRemoved(MarketInteractionMode mode, boolean forUpgrade) {

693        protected CargoAPI getCargoForInteractionMode(MarketInteractionMode mode) {

701                }
702                return cargo;

714        public void clearUnmodified() {
715                if (supply != null) {
716                        for (String id : new ArrayList<String>(supply.keySet())) {
717                                MutableCommodityQuantity stat = supply.get(id);
718                                if (stat != null && (stat.getQuantity().isUnmodified() || stat.getQuantity().getModifiedValue() <= 0)) {
719                                        supply.remove(id);
720                                }
721                        }
722                }
723                if (demand != null) {
724                        for (String id : new ArrayList<String>(demand.keySet())) {
725                                MutableCommodityQuantity stat = demand.get(id);
726                                if (stat != null && (stat.getQuantity().isUnmodified() || stat.getQuantity().getModifiedValue() <= 0)) {
727                                        demand.remove(id);
728                                }
729                        }
730                }
731        }

818        public Pair<String, Integer> getMaxDeficit(String ... commodityIds) {
819                Pair<String, Integer> result = new Pair<String, Integer>();
820                result.two = 0;
821                if (Global.CODEX_TOOLTIP_MODE) return result;
822                for (String id : commodityIds) {
823                        int demand = (int) getDemand(id).getQuantity().getModifiedValue();
824                        CommodityOnMarketAPI com = market.getCommodityData(id);
825                        int available = com.getAvailable();
826                        
827                        int deficit = Math.max(demand - available, 0);
828                        if (deficit > result.two) {
829                                result.one = id;
830                                result.two = deficit;
831                        }
832                }
833                ListenerUtil.modifyIndustryMaxDeficit(this, result, commodityIds);
834                return result;
835        }
836        
837        public List<Pair<String, Integer>> getAllDeficit() {
838                List<String> commodities = new ArrayList<String>();
839                for (MutableCommodityQuantity curr : demand.values()) {
840                        commodities.add(curr.getCommodityId());
841                }
842                return getAllDeficit(commodities.toArray(new String[0]));
843        }
844
845        public List<Pair<String, Integer>> getAllDeficit(String ... commodityIds) {
846                List<Pair<String, Integer>> result = new ArrayList<Pair<String,Integer>>();
847                for (String id : commodityIds) {
848                        int demand = (int) getDemand(id).getQuantity().getModifiedValue();
849                        CommodityOnMarketAPI com = market.getCommodityData(id);
850                        int available = com.getAvailable();
851                        
852                        int deficit = Math.max(demand - available, 0);
853                        if (deficit > 0) {
854                                Pair<String, Integer> curr = new Pair<String, Integer>();
855                                curr.one = id;
856                                curr.two = deficit;
857                                result.add(curr);
858                        }
859                }
860                return result;
861        }

1277                        }
1278                        if (hasDemand) {
1279                                tooltip.beginIconGroup();
1280                                tooltip.setIconSpacingMedium();
1281                                float icons = 0;
1282                                for (MutableCommodityQuantity curr : demand.values()) {
1283                                        int qty = curr.getQuantity().getModifiedInt();
1284                                        if (qty <= 0) continue;
1285                                        
1286                                        CommodityOnMarketAPI com = orig.getCommodityData(curr.getCommodityId());
1287                                        int available = com.getAvailable();
1288                                        
1289                                        int normal = Math.min(available, qty);
1290                                        int red = Math.max(0, qty - available);
1291                                        
1292                                        if (mode != IndustryTooltipMode.NORMAL) {
1293                                                normal = qty;
1294                                                red = 0;
1295                                        }
1296                                        if (normal > 0) {
1297                                                tooltip.addIcons(com, normal, IconRenderMode.NORMAL);
1298                                        }
1299                                        if (red > 0) {
1300                                                tooltip.addIcons(com, red, IconRenderMode.DIM_RED);
1301                                        }
1302                                        icons += normal + Math.max(0, red);
1303                                }
1304                                int rows = (int) Math.ceil(icons / maxIconsPerRow);
1305                                rows = 3;
1306                                rows = 1;
1307                                tooltip.addIconGroup(32, rows, opad);
1308                        }
1309                        
1310                        addPostDemandSection(tooltip, hasDemand, mode);
1311                        
1312                        if (!needToAddIndustry) {
1313                                //addAICoreSection(tooltip, AICoreDescriptionMode.TOOLTIP);
1314                                addInstalledItemsSection(mode, tooltip, expanded);
1315                                addImprovedSection(mode, tooltip, expanded);
1316                                
1317                                ListenerUtil.addToIndustryTooltip(this, mode, tooltip, getTooltipWidth(), expanded);
1318                        } else {
1319                                ListenerUtil.addToIndustryTooltipIfIndustryNotPresent(this, mode, tooltip, getTooltipWidth(), expanded);
1320                        }
1321                        
1322                        tooltip.addPara("*Shown production and demand values are already adjusted based on current market size and conditions, but not items.", gray, opad);
1323                }
1324                
1325                if (needToAddIndustry) {
1326                        unapply();
1327                        market.getIndustries().remove(this);
1328                }
1329                market = orig;
1330                market.setRetainSuppressedConditionsSetWhenEmpty(null);
1331                if (!needToAddIndustry) {
1332                        reapply();
1333                }
1334                market.reapplyConditions();
1335        }

1724        protected void modifyStabilityWithBaseMod() {
1725                int stabilityMod = getBaseStabilityMod();
1726                int stabilityPenalty = getStabilityPenalty();
1727                if (stabilityPenalty > stabilityMod) {
1728                        stabilityPenalty = stabilityMod;
1729                }
1730                stabilityMod -= stabilityPenalty;
1731                if (stabilityMod > 0) {
1732                        market.getStability().modifyFlat(getModId(), stabilityMod, getNameForModifier());
1733                }
1734//              else if (stabilityMod < 0) {
1735//                      String str = getDeficitText(getStabilityAffectingDeficit().one);
1736//                      market.getStability().modifyFlat(getModId(), stabilityMod, getNameForModifier() + " (" + str.toLowerCase() + ")");
1737//              }
1738        }

1747        protected int getStabilityPenalty() {
1748                float deficit = getStabilityAffectingDeficit().two;
1749                if (deficit < 0) deficit = 0;
1750                return (int) Math.round(deficit);
1751        }

1754        protected void addStabilityPostDemandSection(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, boolean hasDemand, IndustryTooltipMode mode) {
1755                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
1756                float opad = 10f;
1757                
1758                MutableStat fake = new MutableStat(0);
1759                int stabilityMod = getBaseStabilityMod();
1760                int stabilityPenalty = getStabilityPenalty();
1761
1762                if (stabilityPenalty > stabilityMod) {
1763                        stabilityPenalty = stabilityMod;
1764                }
1765                
1766                String str = getDeficitText(getStabilityAffectingDeficit().one);
1767                fake.modifyFlat("1", stabilityMod, getNameForModifier());
1768                if (stabilityPenalty != 0) {
1769                        fake.modifyFlat("2", -stabilityPenalty, str);
1770                }
1771                
1772                int total = stabilityMod - stabilityPenalty;
1773                String totalStr = "+" + total;
1774                if (total < 0) {
1775                        totalStr = "" + total;
1776                        h = Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor();
1777                }
1778                float pad = 3f;
1779                if (total >= 0) {
1780                        tooltip.addPara("Stability bonus: %s", opad, h, totalStr);
1781                } else {
1782                        tooltip.addPara("Stability penalty: %s", opad, h, totalStr);
1783                }
1784                tooltip.addStatModGrid(400, 35, opad, pad, fake, new StatModValueGetter() {
1785                        public String getPercentValue(StatMod mod) {
1786                                return null;
1787                        }
1788                        public String getMultValue(StatMod mod) {
1789                                return null;
1790                        }
1791                        public Color getModColor(StatMod mod) {
1792                                if (mod.value < 0) return Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor();
1793                                return null;
1794                        }
1795                        public String getFlatValue(StatMod mod) {
1796                                return null;
1797                        }
1798                });
1799        }

1822        public void setDisrupted(float days, boolean useMax) {
1823                if (!canBeDisrupted()) return;
1824                
1825                boolean was = isDisrupted();
1826                String key = getDisruptedKey();
1827                
1828                MemoryAPI memory = market.getMemoryWithoutUpdate();
1829                float dur = days;
1830                if (useMax) {
1831                        dur = Math.max(memory.getExpire(key), dur);
1832                }
1833                
1834                if (dur <= 0) {
1835                        memory.unset(key);
1836                } else {
1837                        memory.set(key, true, dur);
1838                }
1839                
1840                if (!was) {
1841                        notifyDisrupted();
1842                }
1843        }
1844        
1845        public float getDisruptedDays() {
1846                String key = getDisruptedKey();
1847                float dur = market.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getExpire(key);
1848                if (dur < 0) dur = 0;
1849                return dur;
1850        }

1911        protected float getDeficitMult(String ... commodities) {
1912                float deficit = getMaxDeficit(commodities).two;
1913                float demand = 0f;
1914                
1915                for (String id : commodities) {
1916                        demand = Math.max(demand, getDemand(id).getQuantity().getModifiedInt());
1917                }
1918                
1919                if (deficit < 0) deficit = 0f;
1920                if (demand < 1) {
1921                        demand = 1;
1922                        deficit = 0f;
1923                }
1924                
1925                float mult = (demand - deficit) / demand;
1926                if (mult < 0) mult = 0;
1927                if (mult > 1) mult = 1;
1928                return mult;
1929        }

1932        protected void addGroundDefensesImpactSection(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, float bonus, String ...commodities) {
1933                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
1934                float opad = 10f;
1935                
1936                MutableStat fake = new MutableStat(1);
1937
1938                fake.modifyFlat("1", bonus, getNameForModifier());
1939                
1940                if (commodities != null) {
1941                        float mult = getDeficitMult(commodities);
1942                        //mult = 0.89f;
1943                        if (mult != 1) {
1944                                String com = getMaxDeficit(commodities).one;
1945                                fake.modifyFlat("2", -(1f - mult) * bonus, getDeficitText(com));
1946                        }
1947                }
1948                
1949                float total = Misc.getRoundedValueFloat(fake.getModifiedValue());
1950                String totalStr = Strings.X + total;
1951                if (total < 1f) {
1952                        h = Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor();
1953                }
1954                float pad = 3f;
1955                tooltip.addPara("Ground defense strength: %s", opad, h, totalStr);
1956                tooltip.addStatModGrid(400, 35, opad, pad, fake, new StatModValueGetter() {
1957                        public String getPercentValue(StatMod mod) {
1958                                return null;
1959                        }
1960                        public String getMultValue(StatMod mod) {
1961                                return null;
1962                        }
1963                        public Color getModColor(StatMod mod) {
1964                                if (mod.value < 0) return Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor();
1965                                return null;
1966                        }
1967                        public String getFlatValue(StatMod mod) {
1968                                String r = Misc.getRoundedValue(mod.value);
1969                                if (mod.value >= 0) return "+" + r;
1970                                return r;
1971                        }
1972                });
1973        }

2146        protected transient Boolean hasInstallableItems = null;
2147        public List<InstallableIndustryItemPlugin> getInstallableItems() {
2148                boolean found = false;
2149                if (hasInstallableItems != null) {
2150                        found = hasInstallableItems;
2151                } else {
2152                        OUTER: for (SpecialItemSpecAPI spec : Global.getSettings().getAllSpecialItemSpecs()) {
2153                                if (spec.getParams() == null || spec.getParams().isEmpty()) continue;
2154                                if (spec.getNewPluginInstance(null) instanceof GenericSpecialItemPlugin) {
2155                                        for (String id : spec.getParams().split(",")) {
2156                                                id = id.trim();
2157                                                if (id.equals(getId())) {
2158                                                        found = true;
2159                                                        break OUTER;
2160                                                }
2161                                        }
2162                                }
2163                        }
2164                        hasInstallableItems = found;
2165                }
2166                ArrayList<InstallableIndustryItemPlugin> list = new ArrayList<InstallableIndustryItemPlugin>();
2167                if (found) {
2168                        list.add(new GenericInstallableItemPlugin(this));
2169                }
2170                return list;
2171        }
